name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard terms for a mutual non-disclosure agreement (MNDA) allowing two parties to exchange confidential information while evaluating a potential business relationship.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA that captures the deal-specific variables (purpose, effective date, term, governing law) and incorporates the MNDA Standard Terms by reference.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for a SaaS/cloud service agreement covering access and use, support, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality between a provider and customer.

name: Cloud Service Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement that captures the deal-specific variables (fees, subscription period, governing law, liability caps) and incorporates the CSA Standard Terms by reference.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Standard terms giving an early-access design partner use of a product in exchange for feedback, while the provider retains ownership of the product and any resulting improvements.

name: Design Partner Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Design Partner Agreement that captures the deal-specific variables (product, program terms, fees, effective date, governing law) and incorporates the Design Partner Standard Terms by reference.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard terms defining uptime and response-time targets for a cloud service, how they are calculated, and the service credits or termination rights available if targets are missed. Designed to be used alongside the Cloud Service Agreement.

name: Service Level Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Service Level Agreement that captures the deal-specific variables (target uptime, response time, support channel) and incorporates the SLA Standard Terms by reference.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for a provider performing professional services and delivering deliverables to a customer under one or more statements of work (SOWs), covering IP assignment, payment, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Professional Services Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Professional Services Agreement that captures the deal-specific Key Terms and SOW variables (services, deliverables, fees, governing law) and incorporates the PSA Standard Terms by reference.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Standard terms governing a provider's processing of personal data on behalf of a customer, including subprocessors, international data transfers (EEA SCCs / UK Addendum), security incident response, and audit rights, in compliance with data protection laws such as the GDPR.

name: Data Processing Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Data Processing Agreement that captures the deal-specific variables (subprocessors, security policy, categories of data, SCC annex details) and incorporates the DPA Standard Terms by reference.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms licensing on-premises or self-hosted software to a customer, covering license scope, restrictions, updates, open source software, warranties, liability, and termination.

name: Software License Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Software License Agreement that captures the deal-specific variables (fees, subscription period, permitted uses, governing law) and incorporates the Software License Standard Terms by reference.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard terms for a business partnership between two companies, including cooperation obligations, trademark licensing for co-marketing, payment terms, dispute escalation, and confidentiality.

name: Partnership Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Partnership Agreement that captures the deal-specific variables (obligations, territory, payment, governing law) and incorporates the Partnership Standard Terms by reference.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Standard terms for a short-term trial or evaluation of a product before a customer commits to a full commercial agreement, covering limited access rights, warranties disclaimers, and termination.

name: Pilot Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Pilot Agreement that captures the deal-specific variables (product, pilot period, fees, governing law) and incorporates the Pilot Agreement Standard Terms by reference.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Standard terms required under HIPAA for a business associate that creates, receives, maintains, or transmits protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity, covering permitted uses, safeguards, subcontractors, and breach notification.

name: Business Associate Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Business Associate Agreement that captures the deal-specific variables (relationship, breach notification period, limitations) and incorporates the BAA Standard Terms by reference.

name: AI Addendum
description: Standard terms supplementing a product agreement to govern the use of AI/ML features, including input and output ownership, model training restrictions, and AI-specific disclaimers.

name: AI Addendum Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper AI Addendum that captures the deal-specific variables (training data, training purposes, restrictions) and incorporates the AI Addendum Standard Terms by reference.
